Messages.Author: legb...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Just back from seeing my brother safely married, and playing a very
interesting three-way Happy families tournament. In the final the unusual
situation arose of Sarah actually having the potential to use the
Dauntain Black magician's special ability [to be burnt as a D action to
burn a !tremere]. So i rushed and killed him before she could cotton on
to it, but i'm VERY confused about how the DBM's ability would work. Does
the magician take a D action to burn himself and the !tremere? Or is he
just burnt a la memories of Mortality or Mummy's tongue and then bye-bye
!Tremere?

i'll enlarge a bit on this tournament probably in the May newsletter
because it may be relevant to questions people have been raising about
demo-ing the game and also to the larger question of Fun vs Competition,
but here i'll just say that the !tremere deck was the real surprise of
the tournament, and has made me a lot less negative about the clan than i
used to be. Happy now, Xian?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
legb...@my-deja.com wrote:
> [opponent had the potential to use]

> Dauntain Black magician's special ability [to be burnt as a D action to
> burn a !tremere]. So i rushed and killed him before she could cotton on
> to it, but i'm VERY confused about how the DBM's ability would work. Does
> the magician take a D action to burn himself and the !tremere? Or is he
> just burnt a la memories of Mortality or Mummy's tongue and then bye-bye
> !Tremere?

If the (D) action (directed at the !tremere - and therefore at your
predator) is successful (unblocked), then you burn Dauntain "to" burn
the !tremere.

--
